Initial release of Text to Video AI Tools.

- Instantly convert text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT) into shareable AI-generated videos.
- Supports uploads up to 200MB; output in 1080p MP4 and other common formats.
- Simple workflow: upload script, specify output style, and receive a video ready to post.
- Built-in credit/token system with anonymous access (100 free credits for 7 days).
- Automatic error handling and session management for fast, seamless video creation.
- Designed for marketers and creators who want studio-quality results without editing software.
